decisions.reason: As a newly launched line closely tied to the core skincare business and given especially visible website commitment, management is likely to justify and continue the investment unless clear failure emerges.
The serum fits the established offer and the firm's innovation path, so with sunk development and launch effort and no reported poor results yet, management would most likely keep it on the market.

Although the website commitment appears less prominent than for Product A, it still sits squarely within the core range and recent launch costs and strategic fit make continuation more likely than withdrawal.
